task.title: Re-run EP5-BROKER-TW-002 with real Shioaji SDK (no mock) for stock+futures sandbox smoke
task.summary_zh: EP5-BROKER-TW-002 之前用 --mock-api 路徑收尾，現在 supervisor PID 1034116 已載入 BROKER_SHIOAJI_API_KEY / SECRET_KEY (len=44 各)，且台灣時間 08:00-20:00 sandbox 窗口內，跑真 Shioaji SDK smoke。要求：(1) 不准用 --mock-api；(2) 證券帳戶 place/cancel/readback/reconcile + 期貨帳戶 place/cancel/readback/reconcile 兩段 evidence 分開；(3) 下單間隔 ≥1s；(4) smoke 跑完 sleep ~5min 後 re-login 確認 stock_account.signed=True 與 futopt_account.signed=True；(5) 全程台灣時間 08:00-20:00 內執行（過 20:00 必須 fail-fast 不硬戳）；(6) requirements.txt 升級 shioaji>=1.2.0,<2.0.0；(7) adapter 必須加 ≥1s per-account thread-local last-submit timestamp gate；(8) live order path 仍須一律 reject；(9) evidence 路徑 support/evidence/EP5-BROKER-TW-002-RERUN-REAL/。

task.next: Acceptance criteria 5 was wrong — signed=True is a production-mode (simulation=False) state that only appears AFTER Sinopac audits the simulation test record. Worker correctly added SHIOAJI_ACCOUNT_UNSIGNED precheck per spec but that blocked the very place_order needed to generate the audit record. Superseded by EP5-BROKER-TW-002-RERUN-REAL-FIX.

blockers.message: Blocked after real Shioaji SDK rerun: stock smoke failed before placement with SHIOAJI_ACCOUNT_UNSIGNED (stock_account.signed=False), futures smoke failed with SHIOAJI_ACCOUNT_MISSING (no futopt_account after login), and 300s post-smoke re-login signed-status confirmed stock_account_signed=false and futopt_account_signed=false. Evidence: support/evidence/EP5-BROKER-TW-002-RERUN-REAL/{stock-smoke.json,futures-smoke.json,signed-status.json}. Live path remained SHIOAJI_LIVE_DISABLED and no real-capital order/cancel was submitted.
